pairs.automorphism_equivariance: R1 orbit-cover construction is natural under R1 isomorphisms and uniform refinements; R2 deck is natural under cover isomorphisms. Any chosen cross-cover isomorphism is moved by independent deck automorphisms.
pairs.canonicality: Canonical functors to COVER2: YES. Canonical identification of the two resulting cover objects: NO.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: No shared carrier. R1 canonically defines an orbit two-sheet cover q_h:B->B/<h>; R2 already is the deck of q:ODir->UDir. Thus both land in the abstract category COVER2 but are independent objects.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: Take an even C8 boundary and any R2 cover with four two-point fibers. If phi is one cover isomorphism, delta_q∘phi is another; target deck automorphism naturality would require delta_q∘phi=phi, impossible.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: COVER2 category plus the R1 definable orbit quotient; an actual cross-object comparison additionally needs a cover isomorphism/realization.
pairs.output_copying_risk: HIGH if one declares h=delta without a carrier realization; LOW for the orbit quotient itself.

pairs.automorphism_equivariance: Common involutive-set forgetful images are equivariant. Cross-carrier conjugacy is not canonical.
pairs.canonicality: No canonical cross-carrier bridge in the frozen languages.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: Both are involutions as permutations, but of unrelated sets. Under frozen A*_S3 direction coherence R3 becomes R2, after which the R1 orbit-cover analysis applies.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: On any coherent S3/S4 model, a hypothetical canonical R1-R3 cover realization would compose with the frozen R3=R2 theorem to give the forbidden canonical R1-R2 identification.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: A common involutive-set language; for stronger comparison, A* plus a noncanonical R1-to-direction-cover realization.
pairs.output_copying_risk: HIGH for direct equality; admissible only as marked realization/conjugacy.

pairs.automorphism_equivariance: Any admissible scalarization must be invariant/equivariant under cycle isomorphisms and must respect frozen R1 uniform-refinement naturality.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: None beyond metatheory; S1 and S5 are unrelated signature branches.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: R4 varies under valuation rescaling while R1 is unchanged; moreover no frozen map identifies B with any S5 carrier.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: A new geometric/realization bridge from S1 into an S5-like model plus a scalarization of the permutation role and scalar-unit comparison.
pairs.output_copying_risk: EXTREME if a scalar readout is selected to equal J.

pairs.automorphism_equivariance: R1 realization remains noncanonical; S6 inversion must be quotiented rather than oriented.
pairs.canonicality: No canonical R1-R5 bridge. With explicit realization and the non-split S6 extension package, a noncanonical composite relation exists.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: Both have C2-flavored involutive information only after forgetting most structure; no common carrier or frozen extension relates them.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: Unrestricted R1 refinements can destroy R1 entirely (C4->C5), while R5 persists in S6; independent carrier automorphisms prevent a canonical realization even when cardinalities happen to match.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: R1 orbit two-cover plus a realization into the S6 direction two-cover, followed by a group-extension half-lift object.
pairs.output_copying_risk: HIGH if one identifies the half-cycle directly with a kernel generator/class.
role_types: inversion quotient of generators of an infinite cyclic kernel

pairs.automorphism_equivariance: Both are equivariant under S3 isomorphisms.
pairs.canonicality: Equality is not forced by S3; it is forced by the frozen irredundant A* package.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: S3_DIRACT2 provides the same ODir carrier and both permutations.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: Frozen M1 and M2 deletion witnesses.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: None beyond S3 for formulation; equality theorem needs frozen A*={VERTICALITY,FIXED_POINT_FREE}.
pairs.output_copying_risk: NONE for frozen A*: its axioms are independent verticality/fixed-point-freeness properties, not equality itself.

pairs.automorphism_equivariance: Scalarization must be invariant under cover automorphisms; R4 comparison must survive or explicitly fix valuation/norm scaling.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: S4 ordered-affine reduct can realize R2 and is the reduct of S5, but it contains no scalarization of the deck role and no R4 normalization.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: mu->c mu changes R4 by 1/c while the entire S4 direction-cover/deck data remain fixed.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: An S5 expansion plus a declared scalarization from the C2/deck structure to a scalar codomain compatible with Cut(K).
pairs.output_copying_risk: EXTREME if scalarization scale is chosen from J.

pairs.automorphism_equivariance: Any half-lift must be quotiented by inversion; projection to z and doubling to the kernel generator class are extension-isomorphism natural.
pairs.canonicality: S6 alone: NO. S6 plus NONSPLIT/NO_ORDER_TWO_LIFT: YES at the quotient-class level, not as raw equality.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: S6 contains the S4 direction-negation action/deck together with the extension p:TurnLift->G2.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: Split model L=Z⊕C2: every lift (a,1) doubles to (2a,0), never to a generator ±(1,0) of the kernel.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: An orientation-free half-lift class in p^-1(z); its existence with double a kernel generator is not forced by S6.
pairs.output_copying_risk: LOW for the non-split axiom (independent extension-class property); HIGH for an axiom directly equating deck output to R5.

pairs.automorphism_equivariance: Scalarizer must be action-isomorphism invariant; R4 is independently norm/valuation scale-sensitive.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: S4 realizes the R3 negation action and is the reduct of S5.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: mu rescaling fixes S4 and hence R3 but rescales R4.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: S5 plus a scalarization of the involutive action and scalar normalization.

pairs.automorphism_equivariance: Projection/action and doubling are natural under extension isomorphisms after inversion quotient.
pairs.canonicality: Not forced by S6; canonical quotient relation after the non-split extension-class axiom.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: S6 couples G2={e,z} to the S4 negation action and has p:TurnLift->G2.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: Split Z⊕C2 extension lacks any lift whose double generates the kernel.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: Orientation-free primitive half-lift class above z and its doubling relation.
pairs.output_copying_risk: LOW for extension-class selection; direct R3=R5 remains ill-typed/illegal.

pairs.automorphism_equivariance: Kernel inversion must not change the scalar readout; comparison must specify behavior under norm, valuation, and scalarizer rescalings.
pairs.canonicality: No common scalar coherence is forced.
pairs.common_frozen_structure: S5 and S6 are distinct refinements of S4. A combined comparison model can contain both but is not a frozen consequence of either alone.
pairs.counterexample_or_noncanonicity_witness: In one fixed combined model, independently vary mu, N, or scalarizer lambda while preserving the other frozen role data; relative scalar outputs vary.
pairs.minimal_formulation_object: Common S5+S6 expansion over S4, an orientation-free kernel scalarizer into K (or a comparable ordered group), embedding into Cut(K), and independent normalizations.
pairs.output_copying_risk: MAXIMAL for a normalization whose only property is J=P_lambda.
